titles.native: スウィング アウト シスターズ

description:
Yuuta has two sisters who are beautiful and very dear to him, but their excessive love makes Yuuta confused. Chiyoko eldest sister who has a feminine personality, kind hearted, good at taking care of the house and his sexy body. And Chinatsu's second sister has a tomboy personality but has a cute face, and a harsh nature that always seeks Yuuta's attention. What will Yuuta do to deal with both of them and who will Yuuta choose from this love triangle?

(Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated)

80 minute full version of Swing Out Sisters.
